plugins.name: Hornero Agenda
plugins.description: Agenda 3.0 on Hornero Signal: a desktop widget of date facts (day, ISO week, quarter, day of year, days remaining) with a year partition bar, from the shared time provider. Dates only; no events source.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showIsoWeek.description: Show the ISO week and week-year row (the 1.x behaviour).

showYearProgress.description: Show the elapsed fraction of the year as a progress bar.

plugins.name: Hornero AI Usage
plugins.description: AI Usage 2.0: bar indicator, provider switcher popover and dashboard card over the normalized horneroctl agent usage records. Quota is shown only when a provider record carries it; otherwise it is unknown.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Audio Deck
plugins.description: Audio Deck: a desktop instrument over the shared media, audio and spectrum providers: the real PipeWire spectrum as VU strips, the current track and the output volume. Real data only.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showSpectrum.description: Show the spectrum. It holds the shared `spectrum` lease, which runs the PipeWire visualiser only while this is on and the widget is loaded.

showArtist.description: Show the artist and album line of the current track.

bandCount.description: Spectrum bands drawn. Fewer bands average neighbouring bands of the real PipeWire spectrum; it never draws more than the provider reports.

plugins.name: Hornero Base Converter
plugins.description: Utility Tools 2.0 base converter: bar quick action (decimal or 0x hex) and compact dashboard detail converting decimal integers to binary/octal/hex and hex back. Invalid digits show errors.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

uppercaseHex.description: Show hexadecimal output in uppercase (the 1.x behaviour).

plugins.name: Hornero Battery
plugins.description: Battery 3.0 on Hornero Signal: contextual bar indicator with a Hornero Glyph and a popover/dashboard module showing charge, time left, rate, health and power profile from the shared power provider. Read-only.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showWhenNoBattery.description: Keep a permanent 'No battery' bar item when Power reports no battery (the 1.x behaviour). Off, the 2.0 default, takes no bar space on desktops.

showPercentage.description: Show the battery percentage in the bar indicator (the 1.x behaviour).

showStateText.description: Append the Power state (charging, fully-charged, discharging, pending-charge) when known (the 1.x behaviour).

lowBatteryPercent.description: Charge percent at or below which, while on battery, a low-battery chip is shown. Adds a chip only; 1.x had no threshold.

plugins.name: Hornero Calculator
plugins.description: Utility Tools 2.0 calculator: bar quick action and compact dashboard detail over a safe tokenizer/recursive-descent parser (+ - * / %, parentheses, decimals, unary minus). Division by zero shows Error.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showKeypad.description: Show the keypad grid in the dashboard panel (the 1.x behaviour).

liveResult.description: Recompute the bar quick action as you type; off keeps 1.x explicit compute on Enter or =.

plugins.name: Hornero Calendar
plugins.description: Calendar 3.0 on Hornero Signal: a desktop widget with a display clock, the full date and a square-celled month grid over the shared time provider. Dates only; no events source.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

twentyFourHour.description: Use a 24-hour large clock (the 1.x HH:mm behaviour); off shows 12-hour AM/PM.

showShellTime.description: Show the shell-formatted time line under the date (the 1.x third line).

showMonthGrid.description: Show the current month grid with today marked.

weekStart.description: First weekday column of the month grid. PluginKit does not expose the locale week start.

dateStyle.description: Date line format: long (17 November 2026), short (17 Nov 2026) or iso (2026-11-17).

plugins.name: Hornero Clipboard
plugins.description: Private clipboard history for the launcher (>clipboard): text only, kept in memory and never written to disk, skips password-manager secrets, with retention, size and excluded-word limits you control. Pause, resume and clear are commands.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

recording.description: Record copied text while the extension is enabled. Off stops the wl-paste watcher entirely.

maxEntries.description: How many entries are held at most; the oldest are dropped first.

retentionMinutes.description: Erase entries after this many minutes; 0 keeps them until the shell restarts.

maxChars.description: Never record a copy longer than this many characters.

excludeWords.description: Comma-separated words; a copy containing any of them (case-insensitive) is never recorded.

skipSensitive.description: Skip copies that a password manager marks as secret (x-kde-passwordManagerHint).

plugins.name: Hornero Color Converter
plugins.description: Utility Tools 2.0 color converter: bar quick hex action and compact dashboard detail converting validated #RGB/#RRGGBB to RGB and HSL and RGB back to hex. Invalid hex shows an error. Shows the current Hornero Chromatic seeds and renders a palette template.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

defaultHex.description: Hex color pre-filled in the dashboard (#336699, the 1.x initial color).

showPreview.description: Show the color preview swatch in the dashboard (the 1.x behaviour).

plugins.name: Hornero Containers
plugins.description: A read-only roster of your Podman and Docker containers: state, image, uptime and published ports. Never starts, stops or pulls anything. Says so plainly when no runtime answers.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

runtime.description: Auto tries Podman first and falls back to Docker; both merges the two lists.

showStopped.description: List stopped and exited containers after the running ones.

maxRows.description: Most containers to list; running ones come first.

refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between runtime queries. Querying pauses in the Gaming experience.

plugins.name: Hornero Countdown
plugins.description: Bar timers: a countdown with 5/10/25 minute presets and a stopwatch behind one indicator, deadline and anchor based so sleep never loses time.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

defaultMinutes.description: Countdown length in minutes used until a preset is chosen.

deadlineEpochMs.description: Saved running deadline in epoch milliseconds (0 when not running). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

totalSeconds.description: Saved countdown length in seconds (0 means the default length). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

remainingSeconds.description: Saved paused time remaining in seconds (0 means a full countdown). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

accumulatedMs.description: Saved elapsed milliseconds while paused. Managed by the stopwatch; do not edit.

startedEpochMs.description: Saved start anchor in epoch milliseconds (0 when paused). Managed by the stopwatch; do not edit.

showTenths.description: Show tenths of a second in the elapsed time.

plugins.name: Hornero Date Calculator
plugins.description: Utility Tools 2.0 date calculator: bar quick action and compact dashboard detail for days-between and add-days on validated YYYY-MM-DD dates, using UTC math to avoid DST drift.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showUtcNote.description: Show the UTC-math note in the dashboard panel (the 1.x behaviour).

plugins.name: Hornero Device Battery
plugins.description: Charge of the wireless things on your desk: game controllers, mice, keyboards, headsets, pens and phones, from UPower. Honest about devices that report no percentage.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

lowPercent.description: At or below this charge a discharging device is marked LOW.

includeInternal.description: Also list the laptop battery and UPS units (the native battery indicator already covers the laptop).

showModel.description: Show the device model name under its kind.

sortBy.description: Lowest charge first, or grouped by kind of device.

plugins.name: Hornero Disk Usage
plugins.description: Disk Usage 3.0 on Hornero Signal: every physical disk as a partition bar with a dimension line, free space and a near-full flag from the shared system provider. Read-only.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

warnPercent.description: Used percent at or above which a disk is flagged as nearly full.

showFreeSpace.description: Show free space under each disk (additive in 2.0) and the nearly-full hint.

plugins.name: Hornero Dual Clock
plugins.description: Dual Clock 2.0: local time next to a second zone (UTC by default, as in 1.x) in the bar, with a details popover. Pure-JS rule-based offsets, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

secondZone.description: Zone shown on the second line (UTC in 1.x). Only zones with a built-in DST rule are offered.

showSeconds.description: Show seconds on both lines (1.x showed HH:mm only).

twentyFourHour.description: Use 24-hour times (the 1.x behaviour); off shows 12-hour AM/PM.

plugins.name: Hornero Emoji
plugins.description: Emoji search in the launcher (>emoji) and an emoji picker card over the bundled Unicode 16.0 table. Local only: no history, no network, your skin tone and result count are settings.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

skinTone.description: Skin tone applied to emoji that have tone variants (people, hands).

maxResults.description: How many emoji the launcher and the card list at most.

showGroup.description: Show the emoji group (for example Animals & nature) next to the name.

plugins.name: Hornero Equalizer
plugins.description: A live spectrum analyser for the bar and its popover over the shell's real PipeWire spectrum. Honest by design: an analyser, not a sound filter; it draws nothing while nothing plays and holds the analyser only while a player is playing.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

barBands.description: How many bands the bar indicator draws.

popoverBands.description: How many bands the popover analyser draws.

peakHold.description: Draw a peak tick above each popover band, derived from recent real samples.

analyseWhen.description: playing runs the shared analyser only while a media player plays; always also covers apps without a player.

whenSilent.description: glyph keeps the indicator button while silent; hide removes it until sound plays.

plugins.name: Hornero Focus Card
plugins.description: Focus Card 2.0: dashboard card with the locale date and a rotating original one-line focus reminder, from PluginKit Time. Keyboard Previous/Next and pause, optional own leading line, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

rotateSeconds.description: Seconds each focus line stays on screen (30 in 1.x).

customLine.description: Optional own focus line, shown first in the rotation. Empty (the 1.x behaviour) rotates the built-in lines only.

plugins.name: Hornero Forge Board
plugins.description: CI and pull-request status for the GitHub repositories you name, through the gh CLI session you already signed in. Read-only; stores and sees no token.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

repositories.description: GitHub repositories as owner/name separated by spaces, commas or semicolons. Empty requests nothing.

maxRepositories.description: How many listed repositories to query (two gh calls each per refresh).

refreshMinutes.description: Minutes between refreshes. Requests pause in the Gaming experience.

showPullRequests.description: Also list your open pull requests (author: you) with review and check state.

maxPullRequests.description: Most pull requests shown per repository.

plugins.name: Hornero Git Board
plugins.description: A read-only status board for the repositories you name: branch, ahead/behind, staged, changed, untracked and conflicted counts and the last commit. Local git only, no network, never writes.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

repositories.description: Absolute repository paths separated by semicolons, for example /home/you/code/app;/home/you/code/lib. Empty scans nothing.

maxRepositories.description: How many of the listed repositories to read (each one costs two short git runs per refresh).

refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between scans. Scanning pauses in the Gaming experience.

sortBy.description: Attention puts conflicted, dirty and unsynced repositories first; path keeps your order alphabetical.

showLastCommit.description: Show the last commit subject and age (one extra git run per repository).

showCleanDetails.description: Keep the last commit line on clean repositories; off gives a tighter board.

plugins.name: Hornero JSON Tools
plugins.description: Utility Tools 2.0 JSON tools: bar quick format/validate action and compact dashboard detail with Format and Minify using JSON parse/stringify only. Parser errors are shown.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

indentSpaces.description: Spaces per indent level for Format (2, the 1.x formatting).

defaultAction.description: Action run by the bar quick action (Format, the 1.x primary button).

plugins.name: Hornero Metronome
plugins.description: Metronome 2.0: compact bar metronome with a popover (BPM slider plus minus/plus), deadline-scheduled beats that skip missed beats after sleep, and optional first-beat accent. No processes, no network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

bpm.description: Metronome tempo in beats per minute (40-208).

beatsPerBar.description: Beats per bar used for the accented first beat.

accentFirstBeat.description: Flash the first beat of each bar in the accent colour.

plugins.name: Hornero Microphone
plugins.description: Audio Extensions 2.0: compact bar indicator, details popover and dashboard card for microphone state over the shared PluginKit Audio facade, with honest muted and no-input-device states. Never records audio.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showPercentage.description: Show the microphone volume percentage next to the bar indicator.

showWhenNoSource.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled as no input device, when no source is present.

plugins.name: Hornero Moon Phase
plugins.description: Moon Phase: desktop widget and bar indicator for the approximate moon phase and illumination from the 1.x synodic approximation, plus Desktop Widgets 2.0 size classes, per-display slot display and hide-with-restore. Always labelled approximate.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showIllumination.description: Show the approximate illumination percentage (the 1.x behaviour).

showAge.description: Show the approximate moon age in days (the 1.x behaviour).

showNextPhases.description: Show approximate days to the next new and full moons, derived from the same synodic approximation.

dataDensity.description: compact shows only the phase name; standard keeps the 1.x rows; detailed adds the approximation note.

hemisphere.description: Where you observe from. The waxing moon is lit on the right in the northern hemisphere and on the left in the southern one.

plugins.name: Hornero Network Monitor
plugins.description: Network Monitor 3.0 on Hornero Signal: a download oscilloscope and upload trace from the shared Telemetry history with peak readouts, plus current speeds and session totals. Read-only.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showSessionTotals.description: Show downloaded/uploaded session totals from the Network service (the 1.x behaviour).

showHistory.description: Show the download oscilloscope, upload trace and peak readouts from the shared telemetry history.

plugins.name: Hornero Network Scope
plugins.description: Network Scope: a desktop instrument over the shared network provider: download and upload oscilloscopes with stated scales, current rates, Wi-Fi signal and session totals. Real telemetry only.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showSessionTotals.description: Show the downloaded/uploaded totals since the shell started.

showNetworkName.description: Show the Wi-Fi network name (personal data; off by default on an always-visible desktop widget).

scale.description: Vertical scale of both traces. auto follows the recent peak; a fixed scale makes traces comparable over time (samples above it are clipped at the top).

plugins.name: Hornero Now Playing
plugins.description: Now Playing 2.0: compact bar indicator, details popover and dashboard card over the shared PluginKit Media (MPRIS) facade, with graceful no-player and idle-player states.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showArtist.description: Show the track artist under the title when the player reports one.

showWhenNoPlayer.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled as no player, when no media player is active.

maxTitleWidth.description: Maximum width in pixels for the track title in the bar.

plugins.name: Hornero Pomodoro
plugins.description: Pomodoro: a bar focus timer with short and long breaks, deadline-correct timing across sleep and reload, and an optional hook that switches the shell to the Focus experience while you focus and puts your mode back afterwards.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

longBreakMinutes.description: Long break length in minutes, after a full set of focus sessions.

cyclesBeforeLongBreak.description: Focus sessions in a set before the long break.

autoStartNext.description: Start the next phase by itself instead of waiting for you.

experienceHook.description: Focus: switch the shell to the Focus experience during focus phases and restore your mode after. Needs horneroctl.

deadlineEpochMs.description: Saved running deadline in epoch milliseconds (0 when not running). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

remainingSeconds.description: Saved paused time remaining in seconds (0 means a full session). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

phase.description: Saved current phase. Managed by the timer; do not edit.

setCount.description: Saved focus sessions finished in this set. Managed by the timer; do not edit.

plugins.name: Hornero Port Watch
plugins.description: What is listening on this machine, and what is free: ports, protocol, how far each bind reaches and the owning process when the kernel lets you see it. Watch the ports your projects need. Read-only, local.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

protocols.description: Which protocols to list. UDP has no listen state, so bound UDP sockets are shown.

scope.description: All shows everything; exposed only binds on every interface; local only binds reachable from this machine.

watchedPorts.description: Ports to keep on the board even when free, separated by commas or spaces, for example 3000, 5173, 8080.

maxRows.description: Most rows to show; watched ports come first, then ascending port.

refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between socket table reads. Reading pauses in the Gaming experience.

showProcess.description: Show the owning process name and pid where the kernel exposes them to your user.

plugins.name: Hornero Quick Notes
plugins.description: Quick Notes 2.0: dashboard card with one persistent note saved through PluginKit Settings (same key as 1.x). Debounced autosave, Ctrl+S, flush on unload, clear confirmation, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

note.description: Persistent quick note text (max 4096 characters). Same key as 1.x; existing notes are kept.

autoSaveDelayMs.description: Debounce before an edit is saved automatically (600 ms in 1.x). Ctrl+S and unload always save immediately.

showCounts.description: Show the character/word count line (shown in 1.x).

plugins.name: Hornero Quiet Notes
plugins.description: Quiet Notes 2.0: dashboard card for one short session-only intention. The line is never saved (in-memory only, as in 1.x) and the card says so. Keyboard-first capture, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

maxLength.description: Maximum characters for the session intention (140 in 1.x). Preference only: the intention itself is never stored.

showCounter.description: Show the remaining-characters hint while editing (shown in 1.x).

plugins.name: Hornero Stopwatch
plugins.description: Stopwatch 2.0: compact bar stopwatch with a popover, wall-clock-anchored elapsed time correct across sleep/reload and an optional tenths display. Pure QML, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showTenths.description: Show tenths of a second in the elapsed time.

accumulatedMs.description: Saved elapsed milliseconds while paused. Managed by the stopwatch; do not edit.

startedEpochMs.description: Saved start anchor in epoch milliseconds (0 when paused). Managed by the stopwatch; do not edit.

plugins.name: Hornero Studio Audio
plugins.description: Audio Extensions 2.0: bar indicator, popover and dashboard card for the Studio audio mode and Temporary Performance state from the typed horneroctl contract. Read-only; mode changes stay in the CLI and Control Center.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between studio mode refreshes from horneroctl.

showWhenUnavailable.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled as unavailable, when horneroctl returns no usable studio mode.

plugins.name: Hornero Studio Jobs
plugins.description: Render and export job monitor for HorneroOS Studio: shows queued, running, finished and interrupted jobs from the typed horneroctl studio jobs contract. Read-only; jobs are submitted and cancelled from the CLI or Control Center.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between reads of the Studio job list.

maxRows.description: Most jobs listed, newest first as horneroctl reports them.

showAdapter.description: Show the tool that runs each job (ffmpeg, blender) before its state.

showFinished.description: Keep succeeded, failed and cancelled jobs in the list; off shows only queued and running ones.

plugins.name: Hornero Sun Card
plugins.description: Sun Card 2.0: dashboard astronomy card and contextual bar indicator with sunrise/sunset from PluginKit Weather plus derived day length, sun progress and next sun event. Approximations are labelled derived.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showTemperature.description: Show temperature and description from the Weather facade (the 1.x behaviour).

showHumidity.description: Show relative humidity when the Weather facade reports it (the 1.x behaviour).

showAstronomy.description: Show astronomy detail derived from sunrise/sunset: day length, sun progress and the next sun event.

dataDensity.description: compact shows only sunrise/sunset; standard keeps the 1.x rows plus astronomy; detailed adds the unavailable-fields note.

plugins.name: Hornero System Health
plugins.description: System Health 3.0 on Hornero Signal: a health rack over the shared system, power and network providers: segmented meters that cross to signal at your thresholds, status chips and troubleshooting hints. Read-only.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

warnPercent.description: Usage percent at or above which a CPU, memory or storage row needs attention.

batteryWarnPercent.description: Battery percent at or below which a discharging battery needs attention.

showNetwork.description: Show the download/upload rows from the Network service (the 1.x behaviour).

showHints.description: Show a short troubleshooting hint under rows that need attention.

plugins.name: Hornero System Insight
plugins.description: System Insight: a desktop instrument over the shared system provider: a CPU oscilloscope from the shared Telemetry history, segmented meters, per-core load strips and temperatures. Real telemetry only.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showCores.description: Show one vertical load strip per logical CPU when the widget is tall enough.

showTemperatures.description: Show CPU/GPU temperatures and memory use when the system provider reports them.

warnPercent.description: Usage percent at or above which a meter segment turns signal (the visual language default is 85).

showGpu.description: Show the GPU meter (it already reads as unavailable when the system provider has no GPU data).

temperatureUnit.description: Unit for the CPU and GPU temperatures. The provider reports Celsius; Fahrenheit is a display conversion.

plugins.name: Hornero System Monitor
plugins.description: System Monitor 3.0 on Hornero Signal: a CPU oscilloscope from the shared Telemetry history, segmented meter rows for CPU, memory, GPU and storage with a user threshold, and peak/average readouts. Read-only.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

warnPercent.description: Usage percent at or above which a row is flagged as high. Adds an alert chip only; 1.x had no threshold.

showTemperatures.description: Show CPU/GPU temperatures when the System service reports them (the 1.x behaviour).

showHistory.description: Show the CPU oscilloscope and peak/average readouts from the shared telemetry history.

plugins.name: Hornero Text Tools
plugins.description: Utility Tools 2.0 text tools: bar quick transform and compact dashboard detail with Uppercase, Lowercase, Title Case and Reverse plus character, word and line counts. Pure QML.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

defaultMode.description: Transform preselected in the dashboard and used by the quick action (Uppercase, the 1.x default).

showCounts.description: Show character, word and line counts in the dashboard (the 1.x behaviour).

plugins.name: Hornero Toolbox
plugins.description: Seven everyday tools in one Signal card: calculator, unit converter (with data sizes), base converter, colour with WCAG contrast, date maths, JSON format/minify and text transforms. Local arithmetic only.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

defaultTool.description: Tool shown when the card opens.

showKeypad.description: Show the calculator keypad under the expression.

precision.description: Decimal places kept in unit conversions.

defaultHex.description: Colour pre-filled in the Colour tool (#RGB or #RRGGBB).

showUtcNote.description: Show the UTC arithmetic note in the Dates tool.

indentSpaces.description: Spaces per indent level for JSON Format.

showCounts.description: Show character, word and line counts in the Text tool.

plugins.name: Hornero Unit Converter
plugins.description: Utility Tools 2.0 unit converter: bar quick action (10 km to mi) and compact dashboard detail for length (m, km, mi, ft), mass (kg, lb) and temperature (C, F, K). Pure JS, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

defaultCategory.description: Dashboard category shown first (Length, the 1.x initial category).

precision.description: Decimal places kept when rounding results (6, the 1.x rounding).

plugins.name: Hornero Uptime
plugins.description: Uptime 2.0: bar indicator plus popover/dashboard session detail (uptime, boot time, idle time) from /proc/uptime with the declared cat command. No PluginKit uptime facade exists; error state instead of a fabricated zero.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between /proc/uptime reads (the 1.x fixed 60-second cadence by default).

showLabel.description: Prefix the bar value with 'Up' (the 1.x behaviour); off shows the duration alone.

showWhenUnavailable.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled unavailable, when /proc/uptime cannot be read (the 1.x behaviour); off hides it until a read succeeds.

plugins.name: Hornero Volume
plugins.description: Audio Extensions 2.0: compact bar indicator, details popover and dashboard card for output volume over the shared PluginKit Audio facade, with honest muted and no-output-device states.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showPercentage.description: Show the output volume percentage next to the bar indicator.

showWhenNoSink.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled as no output device, when no sink is present.

plugins.name: Hornero Weather
plugins.description: Weather 2.0: dashboard card and contextual bar indicator complementing native Weather with configurable density, a local wind-threshold alert and forecast detail from the PluginKit Weather facade only
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

forecastDays.description: Forecast entries to show (the 1.x card showed the first 3).

showHumidity.description: Show relative humidity when the Weather facade reports it (the 1.x behaviour).

showWind.description: Show wind speed in km/h when the Weather facade reports it (the 1.x behaviour).

showSunTimes.description: Show sunrise and sunset times from the Weather facade (the 1.x behaviour).

dataDensity.description: compact shows only temperature and description; standard keeps the 1.x rows; detailed adds the derived forecast range.

windAlertKmh.description: Local high-wind alert threshold in km/h. Not an official alert; 1.x had no threshold.

showSunProgress.description: Dashboard: show day length, the next sun event and daylight progress (derived from today's sunrise and sunset).

barIndicator.description: What the bar indicator shows: the temperature, or sunrise and sunset times.

plugins.name: Hornero World Clock
plugins.description: World Clock 2.0: dashboard card with local, UTC and three selectable cities. Pure-JS rule-based offsets (fixed, EU, US and southern DST rules) labelled per row; no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

city1.description: First city row. Only zones with a built-in DST rule are offered.

city2.description: Second city row. Only zones with a built-in DST rule are offered.

city3.description: Third city row. Only zones with a built-in DST rule are offered.

showLocal.description: Show the local time row (the 1.x behaviour).

showSeconds.description: Show seconds in every row (the 1.x behaviour).

twentyFourHour.description: Use 24-hour times (the 1.x behaviour); off shows 12-hour AM/PM.

barZone.description: Bar indicator: the second time zone shown under your local time.

barShowSeconds.description: Bar indicator: show seconds in the local and second-zone times.
